Job Title:

Sr. Cloud DevOps Engineer

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

In our Information Technology and Global Security team, you will deliver the latest technology infrastructure, transformative software solutions and industry-leading global security for our staff and clients. You will work with the best in the world to design, implement and strategize IT, security, application development, innovation, and solutions in today’s hyperconnected world. You will be part of the technology team that is core to our vision of develop, build and run the future of Integrated Services.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

 

The Sr. Cloud DevOps Engineer will play a key role in building, automating, and operating secure, scalable multi-cloud platforms across Microsoft Azure, GCP, and AWS. In this hands-on role, you will partner with architects, security teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver resilient infrastructure, strengthen automation, and support modern cloud services for a global organization. 
 

What you will do in this role 

  • Implement and maintain secure multi-cloud infrastructure across Azure, GCP, and AWS using Terraform and infrastructure as code best practices. 

  • Extend and support reusable Terraform modules, including module versioning, remote state management, environment separation, and drift remediation. 

  • Build, manage, and improve GitHub-based delivery pipelines, including pull request validation, policy enforcement, and promotion of infrastructure changes across environments. 

  • Deploy and operate cloud-native platforms and services, including Kubernetes environments such as AKS, EKS, and GKE, as well as serverless and container-based services. 

  • Implement secure, private-by-default networking patterns including VNets/VPCs, subnets, peering, routing, private endpoints, DNS resolution, firewalls, and load balancing. 

  • Enforce identity, access, and security controls across cloud environments, including IAM/RBAC, managed identities, workload identity federation, secrets management, encryption, and policy compliance. 

  • Monitor platform health and reliability through observability and alerting tools, while contributing to incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement efforts. 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional global teams to support platform modernization, technical documentation, and operational excellence across distributed environments. 

 

Concentrix is a great match if you: 

  • Have 4–7 years of cloud engineering experience, including at least 2 years building and maintaining infrastructure as code in a collaborative team environment. 

  • Bring strong hands-on production experience across Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and AWS, with the ability to troubleshoot and support cloud environments effectively. 

  • Have solid experience writing, maintaining, and reviewing Terraform configurations, including reusable modules, remote state, and production deployments. 

  • Have experience building or maintaining Git-based CI/CD workflows such as GitHub Actions or equivalent automation pipelines. 

  • Understand core cloud networking concepts including VNets/VPCs, subnets, peering, routing, firewalls, private DNS, connectivity troubleshooting, and load balancing. 

  • Demonstrate knowledge of cloud security fundamentals including IAM, RBAC, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, and compliance-driven controls. 

  • Communicate effectively and collaborate well across global, multicultural teams, with comfort working across regions and time zones. 

 

It will be a plus if you: 

  • Have experience with identity federation for delivery pipelines, such as OIDC or workload identity federation, in place of long-lived secrets. 

  • Have implemented policy-as-code or infrastructure scanning controls using tools such as Checkov, tfsec, or OPA. 

  • Bring experience supporting multi-subscription, multi-account, or multi-project governance and landing zone models. 

  • Have worked with enterprise secrets management and rotation tools such as Azure Key Vault, Google Secret Manager, or similar services. 

  • Have experience with Helm, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux, or related platform engineering capabilities. 

  • Have hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms such as AKS, EKS, or GKE in production environments. 

  • Hold certifications such as AZ-104 or Google Associate Cloud Engineer; Terraform Associate, AZ-500, or CKA are also valued. 

  • Have exposure to FinOps, service mesh, Cloudflare, GitHub Enterprise administration, or AI-enabled cloud services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI. 

 

Power the best version of you! 

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive. 

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”

English (Required)
